integrity: The classification is derived symbolically from the exact sliding equations, with exact Jacobian signs and a direct center-manifold expansion; no numerical evidence is used as proof.
limitations: The result classifies interior pseudo-equilibria and their local bifurcation in the stated sliding field; it does not classify global separatrix connections or all positive-kappa trajectories.
title: Pitchfork phase diagram of the excluded sliding pseudo-equilibria
